text: 据外交部网站，7月18日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在上海会见来华出席世界人工智能大会的印度尼西亚经济统筹部长艾尔朗加。 王毅强调，在两国元首战略引领下，近年来中印尼命运共同体建设取得积极进展。中印尼作为全球南方和新兴经济体代表，发展目标相近、共同利益广泛、互补优势明显。双方要加强发展战略对接，相向而行，积极互动，排除干扰，保持定力，不断深化各领域互利合作，作全球南方团结互助、联合自强的典范。中方赞赏统筹部长先生重申欢迎中资企业赴印尼投资合作，希望印尼为此提供公平公正营商环境。中印尼合作不针对第三方，也不应受第三方干扰。双方要带头捍卫多边贸易体制，
text_en: According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs website, on July 18, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met in Shanghai with Airlangga Hartarto, Indonesia's Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs, who was attending the World Artificial Intelligence Conference. Wang Yi emphasized that under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, positive progress has been made in building a China-Indonesia community with a shared future in recent years. As representatives of the Global South and emerging economies, China and Indonesia share similar development goals, broad common interests, and obvious complementary advantages. Both sides should strengthen the alignment of development strategies, move in the same direction, interact positively, eliminate interference, maintain focus, continuously deepen mutually beneficial cooperation in various fields, and serve as a model for the Global South in unity, mutual assistance, and joint self-reliance. China appreciates the Coordinating Minister's reaffirmation of welcoming Chinese enterprises to invest and cooperate in Indonesia and hopes Indonesia will provide a fair and equitable business environment. China-Indonesia cooperation is not targeted at any third party and should not be interfered with by any third party. Both sides should take the lead in defending the multilateral trading system.
